summary_1line: Sampati recounts how he lost his wings, lived on the Vindhya mountain, and met the ascetic Nishakara who recognized him and questioned his condition.

image_candidates.scene_text: The wingless vulture Sampati crawls painfully down the Vindhya mountain through sharp grass toward the serene hermitage of the sage Nishakara.
The radiant sage Nishakara returns from ablutions, surrounded by lions, bears, snakes, and other creatures moving peacefully around him.
Inside the forest hermitage, the aged sage recognizes the burned and weakened Sampati and questions him about the loss of his wings.
